title: Figure 7: Quantum tomography of Schrödinger-cat states
description: Two 3D mesh surface plots over p and q axes showing two separated peaks with an oscillating interference structure between them, for q0 = 3 (top) and q0 = 4 (bottom). Caption reads "Figure 7. Quantum Tomography of Schrödinger-Cat States" and notes negative probabilities within the interference structure. Data credited to A. Furusawa and H. Yonezawa, University of Tokyo.
